name: wit-ts
description: A standalone WIT (WebAssembly Interface Types) parser for TypeScript — runtime and type-level.

scripts.build:cjs: rm -rf dist/cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --outDir dist/cjs --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --declaration --declarationMap --verbatimModuleSyntax false && cd dist/cjs && for f in $(find . -name '*.js'); do mv "$f" "${f%.js}.cjs"; done && for f in $(find . -name '*.d.ts'); do mv "$f" "${f%.d.ts}.d.cts"; done
